verdict.rationale: BILL markets 'AI-powered spend management' in which every transaction is 'categorized, and automatically compliant' (docs-9). Its pricing page also lists an AI Invoice Coding Agent for multi-line bill coding (docs-8), though that is AP-side bill coding rather than expense coding. Both are thin marketing claims with no detail on how the AI works. Missing for 10: receipt reading/OCR, AI-suggested memos, duplicate detection, fraud detection, detailed docs on AI expense categorization, independent or hands-on corroboration.
